triggers.name: new_event
triggers.title: New Event in Celonis
triggers.help: This trigger can be activated from a skill in Celonis. Use this to trigger recipes based off events in Celonis by passing the Webhook URL below to the Start Workato Recipe action in Celonis Skills. Connect to Celonis to get endpoint URL for Celonis.

input.name: event_name
input.label: Event name
input.hint: Provide an event name that is unique to this recipe. For example, Blocked purchase order event .
